tier: full (drawing document fields + public API): two audit rounds with mutation, actual run
before: measured 2026-10-31: 14 characteristics, M/L/F/T/P, Ø zone, position-only two-row composite, point datum targets; no Ⓢ/ST, SØ, Ⓤ, all around/over, stacked frames, profile composite; only shape-level validation

change.fields: frame sphere (SØ, position), statistical (ST hexagon), unequal (Ⓤ + amount, profile, 0 ≤ U ≤ value), around (all-around / all-over, profile), stacked (independent second frame, position/profile), composite for profile too
change.rules: frameRules + FRAME_RULE: form takes no datums (M/L only straightness/flatness); orientation, concentricity, symmetry, runout need a datum; runout/profile/circularity/cylindricity no M/L on the tolerance; Ø zone only position, straightness, orientation, concentricity; Ⓟ only position/orientation; Ⓣ only orientation/profile and never with Ø or Ⓟ; composite lower row datums a subsequence and smaller value; only rules ISO 1101 and ASME Y14.5 share (standard-specific rules wait for 11③)
change.authoring: editor, workspace commits, chat drawing.set and model ops refuse only a rule break the frame did not already have (step-by-step repair of old frames works); Open never refuses a semantic break, it reports FRAME_RULE
change.datums: DATUM_UNDEFINED counts datum target letters and stacked rows
change.output: sheet SVG/PDF/DXF and 3D annotation data agree; frame numbers as entered (fmtTol, up to 4 decimals, no 0.01 rounding)
change.roundTrip: every drawing commit path goes through the Open reader (readDrawing), so an authored drawing equals its reopened form as JSON (the settings key-order mismatch predated 11①)
change.studio: Geometric control editor: characteristic, tolerance, Ø, material, datums, sphere, all around and stacked visible; projected height, free state, tangent plane, datum modifiers, ST and unequal under a closed Details; a refused change keeps the old value and says why

audits.root: actual runs 02–03: Save → fresh Open not equal as JSON (frame keys, then drawing-settings keys) — fixed; editor too dense — rare options moved under Details; after round 2: second-segment Ø checkbox default — fixed
audits.round1: CHANGES_REQUIRED: high — workspace checked without current frames (edits next to an old broken frame refused); high — an old frame with two breaks could not be repaired; medium — ISO-allowed Ⓜ refused on symmetry/coaxiality; medium — 3D annotation data disagreed with the sheet; low — SØ lost on lower rows, Ⓣ with Ø/Ⓟ accepted; wrong display — frame values rounded to 0.01. 25/29 mutants caught
audits.round2: targeted ACCEPT; 22/28 mutants caught (survivors are wiring/width tests, recorded as follow-ups)
